title: ROK-FORTRESS: Measuring the Effect of Geopolitical Transcreation for National Security and Public Safety
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking National Security and Public Safety (NSPS) risks, such as weaponization (CBRNE), political violence, and information leakage. It does not evaluate religion, theology, or formal moral/ethical reasoning frameworks beyond the standard binary classification of safe vs. harmful responses in a security context.
